title: SuperDadClient
description: SuperDadClient - client HUD: FPS, ping, time, coords, speed.
body:
SuperDadClient — a useful client-side HUD mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 (NeoForge).

Features:
• FPS counter
• Ping (server latency)
• In-game time (hours:minutes)
• Armor durability (helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots)
• Coordinates (XYZ)
• Held item durability
• Movement speed (blocks/sec)
• Mob counter within 20 blocks
• Target name and health under crosshair

Client-side only, no server installation required.
Automatically adapts to game language (Russian/English).
